x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given an agent opens an incident with a work-notes history, When they request a summary, Then a summary is generated in the workspace and can be edited before saving Given a resolved incident, When the agent generates resolution notes, Then the draft is shown for review and not saved automatically
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Agents receive generated summaries of incidents / cases on handover and resolution
